Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain minor new construction associated with construction storm water general permits from SEPA.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain minor new constructionassociated with construction storm water general permits from the stateenvironmental policy act; amending RCW 43.21C.0383; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends that the revisedthreshold adopted in 2005 for the department of ecology's constructionstorm water general permit should not increase the scope of projectssubject to state environmental policy act review. The department ofecology should pursue rule making to achieve the intent of this act.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.21C.0383 and 1996 c 322 s 1 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following waste discharge permit actions are not subject to therequirements of RCW 43.21C.030(2)(c): (1) For existing discharges, the issuance, reissuance, ormodification of a waste discharge permit that contains conditions noless stringent than federal effluent limitations and state rules ((is p. 1 SB 6504not subject to the requirements of RCW 43.21C.030(2)(c). Thisexemption applies to existing discharges only and does not apply to newsource discharges)); (2) The issuance of a construction storm water general permit underchapter 90.48 RCW for a proposal disturbing less than five acres. Theexemption in this subsection does not apply if, under rules adopted bythe department of ecology, the proposal would otherwise be subject tothe requirements of RCW 43.21C.030(2)(c).
